manifest: SBG V6 FINAL ARCHITECTURE CANDIDATE 1 -- immutable configuration manifest
approval_status: NOT APPROVED for holdout. Awaiting explicit reviewer approval. Supersedes artifacts/v6/FREEZE_V6.json (V6-B as first frozen) only if approved.

architecture.name: V6-B gated (C0g)
architecture.selected_by: PROTOCOL_V2 selection rule applied mechanically (FINAL_RESULTS.json: rule.selected_by_rule)
architecture.decision_caveat: Rule is partly post-hoc (see SELECTION_RULE_DISCLOSURE.md). Not fully preregistered.
architecture.reviewer_decision_pending: C1_V6B_minusE (E columns removed from the predictive vector) is the clean-metadata alternative. It tied on the primary metric but failed the small-stratum non-inferiority gate, so the rule did not select it.

feature_roles.predictive_note: alpha, conf, st_act, st_nact, st_unk are in the predictive vector of the rule-selected candidate; they are ALSO logged as execution-quality metadata for every pair.

optional_oracle_available_R2_separate_re.definition: d_R: abstract (exception type, value type, sign, length bucket) difference of return values between base and variant over inputs usable on both sides; delta_out: exact repr difference of return value/exception type over the same inputs. Both REQUIRE executing both program versions on identical inputs and comparing their outputs (differential testing). No ground-truth label or expected-output oracle is used.

policy_P1: NOT_ACTIVATED and UNKNOWN pairs are ABSTAINED at scoring: score = median of the activated training pairs' inner-OOF scores of the same fold. Never interpreted as equivalence. Report all-pairs and activated-only AUROC plus the abstention rate.
classifier_primary: LogisticRegression(L2,max_iter=2000), C in {0.1,1,10}, inner GroupKFold(3) by program, scoring roc_auc
classifier_secondary: HistGradientBoostingClassifier(random_state=0), max_depth in {2,3}, max_iter in {50,100}, same inner CV
outer_cv: 5-fold program-grouped (folds(g,seed)); final holdout model: fit on all DEV with identical recipe

holdouts.metadata_read: only program ids and base-source hashes of v8 test/v10 pair files were read, for a DEV/holdout overlap check (0 overlap). No scores, labels or features were read.
